parameters.content:
## Lead processor (sub-workflow)
Input: `inbox_id`. Resumable and idempotent: every step checks what already happened, so a retry never creates a second CRM contact or a second alert.

1. claim the inbox event (row lock)
2. fetch the Meta lead (falls back to basic fields when campaign names need extra permissions)
3. normalize phone / email / language
4. dedupe + save (SQL, atomic)
5. CRM sync
6. route by time, language, owner
7. notify
8. mark done

parameters.query:
UPDATE leadops.inbox
   SET status = 'processing', locked_at = now(), attempts = attempts + 1
 WHERE id = $1::bigint
   AND (status IN ('pending', 'failed')
        OR (status = 'processing' AND locked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'))
RETURNING id AS inbox_id, source, event_key, payload, attempts;

UPDATE leadops.inquiries
   SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'new' THEN 'notified' ELSE status END,
       notified_at = coalesce(notified_at, now())
 WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING id;

UPDATE leadops.inbox SET status = 'done', processed_at = now(), locked_at = NULL, last_error = NULL
 WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING id AS inbox_id, status, inquiry_id;
